items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: The same lady as the name of Jeanette Kimball. Jeanette Kimball. She was a wonderful piano player.

ctx.x: She didn't have her on piano in those days. They had Miss Kimball, Kimball's wife.

The same lady as the name of Jeanette Kimball. Jeanette Kimball. She was a wonderful piano player. She could play. She was playing. She played a lot of piano, still playing. That was his feature piano. He had Al of Alcon's on Alto. He's in Chicago now.
Oh yeah. That's Alvin's brother. I met him on that.
